# Node ids no fixture may carry. Built from nothing real: the two reserved
# values firmware gives special meaning (0, no sender; ffffffff, broadcast) and
# three placeholder patterns that hand-written test data tends to reach for.
# Every fixture id must also lie in the invented range f1c70000 to f1c7ffff.
!00000000
!ffffffff
!deadbeef
!12345678
!0a0b0c0d
